title: 09 / Membrane: Mycelium
sub: Another telling of 09 / Membrane, the longest breath after the great stroke: the hide turns to glass behind its ripple onto an inner forest of golden threads running to a slow heart of light, its glow over her, while the universe's membrane heaves green and deep all round. 29 seconds, WebGPU, the drum's sound simulated from its own physics.

sub: Another telling of 09 / Membrane. title: 09 / Membrane: Abyss
sub: Another telling of 09 / Membrane. The great stroke's moment held longer and quieter: the ripple crawls out from the struck point and the hide turns to glass behind it, onto a dark inner sea where vast veiled beings of light drift, while the universe's membrane ripples cool and blue all round. 26 seconds, WebGPU, the drum's sound simulated from its own physics.

title: 09 / Membrane
sub: A shaman strikes a great drum three times, each harder than the last, and then once more. Time all but stops as the beater lands: the ripple crawls out from the struck point and the hide turns to glass behind it, onto a realm of serpents and flowers inside the drum, while our universe's membrane ripples and tears open all round. A seamless 22-second loop in WebGPU, the drum's sound simulated from its own physics.

title: 04 / Gyre
sub: Forty glazed hoops, each one flipping over twice a loop, starting from the outside. A seamless 16-second loop, sphere-traced in WebGPU.
